author: Xbox
description:
Witness the Terran Armada at the height of their power as they invade the Settled Systems in the fifth episode of the Starfield Animated Anthology. In “Ab Astris Ad Terram,” the leaders of the Terran Armada test the limits on how far they are willing to go in their unification effort, including the kidnapping of a brilliant roboticist.  
  
The Terran Armada story DLC is available April 7 alongside the Free Lanes Update.
